The Quiet EdgePDF · page 143 of 188
CHAPTER SIX

The room after midnight

The library had gone quiet enough that every page turn seemed louder than it should. Mira looked again at the note she had copied earlier, certain there was a meaning she had missed.

She read the paragraph twice, then moved closer to the window. The margin around the scanned page was wide and uneven, stealing more space than the text itself.

On a small screen, that difference mattered. A tighter crop made the page feel less like a photograph and more like a book again.

She marked the page, lowered the brightness, and continued reading. Select any sentence here to preview the existing MyReader text actions.
